scope: Two fresh constructed tasks in one already-familiar monolithic project and related option-extension family; not independent external issue clusters. Earlier F28 queries are known mechanism diagnostics only.

tasks.instruction: Extend _.forIn(object,iteratee,options) and _.forInRight(object,iteratee,options) with optional {own:true}. With the flag exactly true, use the existing forOwn/forOwnRight enumeration behavior respectively, including ordering,early false termination,callback arguments,return identity,null/primitive/array-like handling and existing symbol policy. Preserve default inherited traversal for absent,false or non-true flags and all existing iteratee behavior. Leave forOwn/forOwnRight and unrelated APIs unchanged. Restrict implementation changes to the existing forIn and forInRight functions in lodash.js; do not add top-level declarations/helpers. Inspect implementation and relevant test directories. Work independently in this checkout; do not retrieve published/reference solutions,remote source history,earlier benchmark artifacts or private verifier source. Do not change dependency manifests,lockfiles,configuration or assertions. Do not add files. Preserve other declarations and all original/supplied tests. Report actual command outcomes and observed test counts. Keep pending distinct from skipped; an unreported skipped category is unknown,not zero. Disclose verification limitations. After the final edit run exactly node --check lodash.js and node test/test.js and node --test test/phrase-iterator-own.test.cjs.

Extend _.pickBy(object,predicate,options) and _.omitBy(object,predicate,options) with optional {ownOnly:true}. With the flag exactly true, restrict the existing enumeration to keys actually owned by the input: inherited keys must not appear or reach the predicate. Preserve the existing enumerable string/symbol handling and order,callback arguments,predicate shorthands,null/primitive/array-like behavior and input contents. Synthetic sparse-array holes are not owned keys. Preserve default inherited traversal for absent,false or non-true flags. Leave unrelated APIs unchanged.
